screens.title: Good morning, Olivia
screens.description: A calm command center for today's virtual office, upcoming sessions, and attendance exceptions.

screens.title: A better place to work together
screens.description: Welcome to Forma: a virtual workspace where teams meet, learn, and keep a clear view of attendance.

screens.title: Sign in to your workspace
screens.description: Sign in with the phone number and password associated with your organization.
screens.notice: Interactive prototype only. No real account, invitation, message, or authentication request is sent.

screens.title: Reset your password
screens.description: Enter your account phone number. For privacy, a real service should not reveal whether an account exists.
screens.notice: Prototype only: no SMS is sent and no phone number is stored.

screens.title: Verify your phone
screens.description: Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone to continue password recovery.
screens.notice: Demo code entry only. No SMS provider is connected.

screens.title: Choose a new password
screens.description: Set a strong password for your account. A real product should enforce its published password policy.
screens.notice: Interactive prototype only. No real account, invitation, message, or authentication request is sent.

screens.title: You're invited to Acme Studio
screens.description: Review the organization and role before accepting a time-limited invitation.
screens.notice: Fictional invitation for prototype navigation. No invitation is accepted or created.

screens.title: Join as a guest
screens.description: Use a workspace-issued guest link to enter a public room with limited access.
screens.notice: Guest access is illustrative; no link is validated and no identity is impersonated.

screens.title: This space isn't available to guests
screens.description: This workspace requires a member account or a guest link scoped to a public room.
screens.notice: Access-denied example only. No authorization decision is performed by this prototype.

screens.title: This link has expired
screens.description: For security, workspace and invitation links can expire. Ask an organization admin for a fresh link.
screens.notice: Interactive prototype only. No real account, invitation, message, or authentication request is sent.

screens.title: Acme Studio virtual office
screens.description: A shared, navigable office with room occupancy, today's sessions, and collaboration controls.
screens.notice: Illustrative map and presence. Real-time movement, room access, and media are not connected.

screens.title: Office map editor
screens.description: Arrange rooms and shared areas, then preview the layout before publishing it to your organization.
screens.notice: Map edits are illustrative and are not saved to an organization.

screens.title: Focus room settings
screens.description: Set a room's name, capacity, access, and availability so members know how to use it.

fields.label: Room description
fields.placeholder: A quiet room for focused work

screens.notice: Room capacity and access settings are demonstration content; no permissions are enforced.

screens.title: Ready to join?
screens.description: Check the room and your device preferences before joining the scheduled meeting.
screens.notice: Camera and microphone previews are not activated; this demo does not request device access.

screens.title: Design standup
screens.description: A live-meeting layout with participants, call controls, consent state, and room information.
screens.notice: Illustrative meeting only. No audio, video, recording, or network session is running.

screens.title: Recording consent
screens.description: Make recording status and participant consent clear before a meeting is recorded.
screens.notice: Consent is a prototype state only. No participant is recorded or notified.

screens.title: People in this meeting
screens.description: Review participant access, speaking status, and recording consent without exposing private data.
screens.notice: Fictional participants and controls; no microphone is muted and no recording consent is collected.

screens.title: Share your screen
screens.description: Choose a share option and review who can see it before presenting in the meeting.
screens.notice: Screen sharing is not activated and this prototype never captures your screen.

screens.title: Recording in progress
screens.description: Show a persistent recording indicator, elapsed time, consent coverage, and a clear stop action.
screens.notice: Recording state is illustrative. No meeting content is captured or uploaded.

screens.title: People at Acme Studio
screens.description: Find people, review their organization role and team, and manage invitations from one directory.
screens.notice: Names and activity are fictional. Member records and invitations are not stored.

screens.title: Invite someone to Acme Studio
screens.description: Choose a role and team, then send a time-limited invitation link to a new member.
screens.notice: Demo form only. No SMS, invitation, or personal data is transmitted or persisted.

screens.title: Olivia Rhye
screens.description: A member profile with role, team, current status, and links to attendance and schedule context.
screens.notice: Fictional profile for demonstration; private member records are not accessed.

screens.title: Roles and permissions
screens.description: Review the least-privilege capabilities available to organization admins, mentors, members, and guests.
screens.notice: Permission matrix is illustrative; access must be enforced server-side in a production service.

screens.title: Teams
screens.description: Group members for shared schedules, reporting, and access to relevant workspaces.
screens.notice: Team names and assignments are fictional examples.

screens.title: Create a team
screens.description: Give a team a clear name, assign a lead, and select members for schedules and reporting.
screens.notice: Team changes are not saved in this prototype.

screens.title: Weekly schedule
screens.description: Plan recurring team sessions across the week with clear timezone and attendance expectations.
screens.notice: Sample schedule only. Times and recurrence are not persisted or synced to calendars.

screens.title: Create a scheduled session
screens.description: Set a one-off or recurring session, assign its audience and room, and define the attendance grace period.
screens.notice: A saved session is not created by this prototype; recurring schedule rules are examples only.

screens.title: Edit Design standup
screens.description: Update a scheduled session while reviewing who is affected and whether past attendance snapshots remain unchanged.
screens.notice: Editing is illustrative. Attendance records are not modified.

screens.title: Organization holidays
screens.description: Mark organization-wide holidays so recurring sessions and attendance expectations are clear.
screens.notice: Example holiday calendar; no dates are applied to real schedules.

screens.title: Add an organization holiday
screens.description: Specify whether a date is a full or partial holiday and how recurring sessions should be handled.
screens.notice: Holiday details are not saved in this prototype.

screens.title: Request time off
screens.description: Submit planned leave with dates and a reason so mentors and administrators can review schedule coverage.
screens.notice: Leave details are fictional and are not submitted or stored.

screens.title: Leave request review
screens.description: Review a pending leave request, check schedule conflicts, and record an auditable decision.
screens.notice: Review actions are simulated; no leave status changes or notifications are made.

screens.title: Attendance report
screens.description: Compare scheduled time with verified presence, punctuality, breaks, and reviewed exceptions.
screens.notice: Illustrative attendance metrics only. No location or device tracking is performed.

screens.title: Phoenix Baker · attendance
screens.description: A member-level view of scheduled sessions, grace-adjusted arrival, confirmed connected time, and corrections.
screens.notice: Fictional member attendance. Confirmed presence and correction history are not real records.

screens.title: Frontend mentorship · session detail
screens.description: Inspect scheduled start and end, attendance events, grace period, and documented session exceptions.
screens.notice: Sample session timeline only; records are not sourced from real presence events.

screens.title: Request an attendance correction
screens.description: Explain a missed or incorrect attendance event. Requests remain pending until an authorized reviewer decides.

fields.label: Reason
fields.placeholder: Describe what happened and why the record should be reviewed

screens.notice: Correction request is a demo state and does not change an attendance record.

screens.title: Attendance corrections
screens.description: Review requested changes with their reason and original record. Approved edits should retain an audit trail.
screens.notice: Fictional review queue. No correction decision or audit event is saved.

screens.title: Review Phoenix's correction
screens.description: Compare the original verified event with the requested change, capture a reviewer reason, and decide fairly.

fields.label: Reviewer note
fields.placeholder: Document the reason for your decision

screens.notice: Approval is not applied. In production, reviewer identity and the before/after values belong in an audit log.

screens.title: Correction decision recorded
screens.description: A confirmation view for the reviewed correction, including the recorded outcome and audit context.
screens.notice: Confirmation state only; no attendance data or audit event has actually changed.

screens.title: Export attendance report
screens.description: Choose a date range, teams, and report fields before preparing a privacy-conscious attendance export.
screens.notice: Export preparation is simulated; no file is generated or downloaded.

screens.title: Attendance notifications
screens.description: Choose which attendance events notify members, mentors, or administrators and how often summaries arrive.
screens.notice: Notification preferences are not saved and no email, SMS, or push notification is sent.

screens.title: Mentor home
screens.description: A focused view of assigned learners, today's sessions, and attendance follow-ups for a mentor.
screens.notice: Mentor scope and learner records are sample data, not real assignments.

screens.title: Your workspace
screens.description: Members can see their own upcoming sessions, attendance progress, and requests without exposing peers' private records.
screens.notice: Illustrative self-service view. A real member should only access their own records.

screens.title: My schedule
screens.description: A member or mentor view of assigned sessions, timezone, room, and approved time away.
screens.notice: Personal schedule is fictional and does not sync with a calendar.

screens.title: Recording history
screens.description: Follow meeting recordings from consent and processing through Drive upload, retry, and retention.
screens.notice: Fictional recording metadata. No meeting audio or video exists in this prototype.

screens.title: Design standup · recording
screens.description: Review consent, processing status, destination, access, and retention for one meeting recording.
screens.notice: Metadata is fictional; playback and download are intentionally unavailable.

screens.title: Recording upload in progress
screens.description: Show upload progress, retry-safe job status, destination folder, and the time of the last update.
screens.notice: Upload progress is illustrative; no file or background transfer exists.

screens.title: Upload needs attention
screens.description: Explain a retryable upload error, protect the original recording, and show the next safe step.
screens.notice: Retry is not executed. A real retry should be idempotent and preserve the source recording.

screens.title: Connect Google Drive
screens.description: Choose an organization-owned Drive destination and review the requested access before connecting.
screens.notice: Drive connection is simulated. No Google account is contacted and no files are read or uploaded.

screens.title: Review Drive access
screens.description: Explain the organization-controlled scope and destination before an administrator authorizes a Drive connection.
screens.notice: Consent screen is illustrative; no Google OAuth request or token is created.

screens.title: Google Drive connected
screens.description: Review connection owner, selected folder, upload policy, and options to revoke access or inspect storage.
screens.notice: Drive connection is simulated. No Google account is contacted and no files are read or uploaded.

screens.title: Drive connection revoked
screens.description: Show the organization that new uploads are paused and recordings remain available for an authorized reconnect.
screens.notice: Revocation is simulated; no account token or Drive access is changed.

screens.title: Recording storage usage
screens.description: Monitor organization recording storage, retention headroom, and the next action when a quota is near its limit.
screens.notice: Storage values are sample data; no Drive metadata is queried.

screens.title: Organization settings
screens.description: Manage organization identity, workspace defaults, privacy policy, and operational controls.
screens.notice: Organization settings are illustrative and do not change a real tenant.

screens.title: Attendance and workspace policies
screens.description: Make attendance calculations, privacy expectations, and room access rules clear and consistent.
screens.notice: Policy choices are examples. Real policies require review for the organization's privacy obligations.

screens.title: Recording retention policy
screens.description: Define recording retention and deletion responsibilities with clear notice to members and auditors.
screens.notice: Retention is not enforced and no files are deleted by this prototype.

screens.title: Organization audit log
screens.description: Review sensitive organization changes with actor, timestamp, target, and an auditable reason.
screens.notice: Sample audit entries only; this is not a security or compliance record.

screens.title: Plans for your organization
screens.description: Compare member and recording limits, then review a plan before continuing to a simulated checkout.
screens.notice: Plan and payment details are illustrative. This prototype does not contact a payment provider or charge a card.

screens.title: Review your Team plan
screens.description: Review plan limits and the illustrative billing summary before a simulated confirmation.
screens.notice: Plan and payment details are illustrative. This prototype does not contact a payment provider or charge a card.

screens.title: Plan updated
screens.description: Confirm the selected plan and provide a path to usage and invoice history.
screens.notice: Plan and payment details are illustrative. This prototype does not contact a payment provider or charge a card.

screens.title: Invoices and billing history
screens.description: Review invoice dates, amounts, and payment status for the organization subscription.
screens.notice: Invoice rows are fictional. There are no downloadable invoices or payment records.

screens.title: Plan usage
screens.description: Understand member, session, and recording usage before reaching a plan limit.
screens.notice: Usage is illustrative and is not metered against a subscription.

screens.title: Platform organizations
screens.description: A restricted super-admin overview of tenant health, plan status, and support follow-ups.
screens.notice: Fictional tenant overview. Platform access is privileged and should be audited and justified.

screens.title: Acme Studio · platform view
screens.description: Review tenant-level configuration and health metadata without opening member content or private recordings.
screens.notice: Support view contains sample operational metadata only; no tenant content is exposed.

screens.title: Create an organization
screens.description: Provision a new tenant with an explicit region, initial plan, and accountable organization owner.
screens.notice: Tenant provisioning is simulated; no organization or user account is created.

screens.title: Platform health
screens.description: Review service availability and operational queue indicators without accessing customer content.
screens.notice: Operational metrics are illustrative and do not represent a live platform.

screens.title: Messages and channels
screens.description: Bring team channels and recent conversations together. Choose a conversation to review its shared context.

screens.notice: Messages and channel activity are fictional. No messages are sent and no content is stored.

screens.title: Connect Google Calendar
screens.description: Review a simulated calendar connection and choose which team schedule may sync before opening the consent step.

screens.title: Calendar sync settings

screens.title: Invitations and guest links
screens.description: Review member invitations and scoped guest links, including expiry, access level, and revocation status.
screens.notice: Link records are fictional. No access token is generated, copied, delivered, or revoked.

screens.title: Create a guest access link
screens.description: Limit a guest link to a room and time window, and choose whether it may be used once or more than once.

actions.label: Create link and return to management

screens.notice: This is a design-only creation flow. It does not mint a secure link or grant access.

screens.title: Guest link revoked
screens.description: Confirm a link is no longer available and explain that revocation does not change a member account or existing recordings.
screens.notice: Revocation confirmation is illustrative. No link, guest session, or permission is changed.

screens.title: Select a Drive folder
screens.description: Choose a destination folder with the narrowest suitable scope before continuing the organization Drive setup.
screens.notice: Folders are fictional. No Drive directory is listed, accessed, or modified.
